announcements.title: Welcome to AfriChat Super-App
announcements.content: Experience secure African remittances, peer-to-peer escrow, and on-demand local dispatch.

marqueeBanner.text: ⚡ Welcome to AfriChat! Zero-fee transfers, instant dispatch deliveries, and escrow protection live across Africa.

faqArticles.question: How does Balogun Escrow Protection work?
faqArticles.answer: When you purchase goods or book an artisan, your payment is held securely in an encrypted vault until you confirm satisfactory delivery.

faqArticles.question: How do PickkR and Gokada dispatch deliveries work?
faqArticles.answer: Our dispatch system matches nearby verified riders. A 5% platform fee guarantees insurance and GPS parcel tracking.

faqArticles.question: How do I avoid scammers on P2P payments?
faqArticles.answer: Use the Scam Shield tool in the 3-dot menu before sending funds. Never release escrow funds until you inspect items physically.

communityGuidelines:
1. Treat all community members with respect.

termsOfService: AfriChat provides communication, marketplace escrow mediation, and logistical dispatch coordination across African regions.
